prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind her, softly lit by blue-hour twilight and warm lamps, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in blue-hour twilight with warm lamps glowing, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Korean woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, a cold, commanding gaze, pure icy-white hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a silver miniature anvil, a silver round bell, a copper pyramid-shaped lump, a bronze small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single silver bracelet. Extra long nails in matching polished jade.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and powerful athletic woman, far beyond any real person; wide capped boulder-like shoulders, a broad flaring back and lats forming a dramatic V-taper, defined muscular arms, a firm chest, a deeply defined six-pack abdomen on a very narrow waist, round firm hips and strong muscular thighs with a visible quad sweep and defined calves; hard clean muscle under glowing skin, not bulky like a bodybuilder, not thin; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body polished jade-green stone fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep jade-green stone surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID pale-green cloudy vein striations flowing through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her face and ears are real living skin, and her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved jade-green stone.

LEFT Cracks: the jade-green stone body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her right calf, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her left forearm and one at her left hip, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw grey-green stone with a rough waxy surface, much duller than the polished jade outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the jade-green stone is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
LEFT Pose: wide power stance, both fists lightly closed at her sides, chin up.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme pointed platform stiletto pumps in black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved jade-green stone right down to the shoes.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Iranian man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, dramatic black smoky eyeshadow with sharp winged eyeliner, olive skin with a warm undertone, a shy sweet smile, warm honey-blonde hair styled in braided, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large copper hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a lead round bell, a silver ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum hair ornaments. Extra long nails in matching polished rhodonite.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: full body polished rhodonite fused directly to his own form wrapping his whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow his body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING rich rose-pink rhodonite surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID black manganese vein striations flowing through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. His face and ears are real living skin, and his neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and his shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved rhodonite.

RIGHT Cracks: the rhodonite body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across his right hip, and one chipped-off piece at his right shoulder, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw pale pink-grey stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including his chest, the rhodonite is smooth, polished and whole, and his face, ears and neck are living skin.
RIGHT Pose: wide power stance, both fists lightly closed at his sides, chin up.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme platform stiletto pumps in nude leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with his legs and ankles staying solid carved rhodonite right down to the shoes.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the twilight and the warm lamp light in soft glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
